marketing.ttl: 9月社媒趋势：从怀旧档案到'具体化'内容
marketing.sum: Pepper Agency 梳理 TikTok & Instagram 9月趋势：品牌应从自有档案挖怀旧素材，内容走向'具体而非泛化''普通而非 aspirational'，并提前布局圣诞发现季。
marketing.body: September is a good example of why social strategy needs to look beyond whatever audio happens to be trending. Audiences are responding to specificity over mass relatability, ordinary experiences over constant aspiration, and useful content that actually earns attention. Christmas discovery is already happening — if gifting matters commercially, September should be part of your Christmas strategy.

marketing.sum: TIME Marketing 盘点本月胜出的5个格式：给产品贴满水钻、双人格对比、'-aholic'执念宣言、'5件我不做'、'让我猜'——核心是让人'被看见'先于读完。
marketing.body: September 2026 is leaning into personality, specificity, and a little bit of chaos. The formats winning right now are the ones that make people feel seen before they even finish reading — bedazzle everything, map your range onto two personalities, or name your one true obsession with '-aholic'.

marketing.ttl: 创意热榜：KFC'被裁邮差'、DiDi'输家储蓄'、ING'储蓄很潮'
marketing.sum: Campaign Brief 澳洲创意圈月度精选：KFC澳洲'被裁邮差明信片'、DiDi' Sore Loser Saver'、ING' Saving is in'等，强调'等对时机'与'把无聊品类做有趣'。
marketing.body: KFC's 'Sacked Postie Postcard' shows the power of waiting for the right moment. Ogilvy's 'Saving is in' for ING takes on the most boring category and makes it genuinely funny — a confident list of what you refuse to do is a positioning statement disguised as a trend.

marketing.ttl: Zendaya 如何成为时尚创意引擎：从代言到产品共创
marketing.sum: RetailBoss 深度：Zendaya 以 Law Roach 造型体系串联 LV、On、Vogue 等多点叙事，品牌应将代言预算从一次性 campaign 转向长期创意合作。
marketing.body: The common thread is consistency. Styled with Law Roach, every campaign, editorial and premiere reinforces a single visual identity while creating commercial value for luxury, performance, jewellery, watches and beauty partners. As celebrity partnerships become more product-led, should brands shift ambassador budgets to long-term creative collaborations?

marketing.ttl: 初创公司社媒趋势：品牌要像'有 stakes 的人'
marketing.sum: Mean CEO 的创始人视角：9月趋势要求内容战略重写——团队多出镜、本地语境是资产、AI 留在幕后、内容回答搜索意图而非仅宣布存在。
marketing.body: Your brand should behave more like a person with stakes. Your team should appear in content more often. Your local context is an asset, not a weakness. Your AI use should stay mostly backstage. Content should answer search intent, not just announce existence.

tech.ttl: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，奥特曼首提自研人形机器人
tech.sum: OpenAI 9月3日发布旗舰模型 GPT-6 Astra，称实现'代际跃迁'，可自主完成长周期多步骤任务；奥特曼首次明确将做人形机器人。API 定价约为 GPT-5.6 的2.5倍。
tech.body: Astra uses over 100,000 GPUs trained at Stargate, Texas; it can enter software environments and autonomously complete programming, financial modeling, presentations and spreadsheets. OpenAI says this marks the arrival of the agent era, and Altman confirmed the company 'will definitely build humanoid robots.'

tech.ttl: 英伟达 129.3 亿美元收购 Hugging Face
tech.sum: 英伟达宣布以约129.3亿美元收购开源模型平台 Hugging Face，承诺维持开放平台；其托管超300万个模型、1800万开发者。
tech.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced a ~$12.93B acquisition of Hugging Face, the world's largest open-source AI model platform with 300M+ models and 18M+ developers, reshaping the global open-source AI ecosystem and Nvidia's hardware dominance.

tech.ttl: 工信部启动人工智能中小企业创业支持计划 + AI应用服务商培育
tech.sum: 工信部启动三年培育计划（万家科技型中小企业、10个孵化器），并提出到2026年底 AI 应用服务商资源池突破2000家。
tech.body: MIIT launched a three-year startup support plan for AI SMEs and an AI service-provider cultivation campaign targeting 2,000+ providers by end-2026, bridging tech supply and industry adoption and unblocking规模化 promotion.

tech.ttl: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.3，AI模型竞赛白热化
tech.sum: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.3，编码与智能体任务逼近头部；Google 推 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Anthropic 推 Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1，前沿模型趋于'受限开放'。
tech.body: The proliferation of gated and conditionally available models — Mythos 5.1 and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber — signals frontier labs are increasingly restricting access to their most capable models for security and competitive reasons.

tech.ttl: '豆包手机'努比亚 NaviX Ultra 本月上市，VAST 半年融资约50亿
tech.sum: 全球首款 AI 智能体手机努比亚 NaviX Ultra 获入网许可、本月开售；3D 生成公司 VAST 半年累计融资约50亿元。
tech.body: ZTE's Nubia NaviX Ultra, the world's first AI-agent phone, cleared MIIT certification and launches in September; 3D-AI startup VAST raised ~¥5B in under six months, betting on 3D-native models as the next content-production paradigm.

daily.ttl: 体育产业2030年目标超7万亿元，'十五五'规划发布
daily.sum: 国新办发布会：到2030年体育产业总规模超7万亿元；工信部等10部门印发《促进中小企业发展'十五五'规划》。
daily.body: By 2030, China aims for a sports industry exceeding 7 trillion yuan; the '15th Five-Year' SME plan targets 22,000 'little giant' firms and 600 national SME clusters.

daily.ttl: 全国学生总体近视率近五年连续下降
daily.sum: 国家疾控局：2025年全国学生总体近视率49.9%，较2018年累计降3.7个百分点，近五年连续下降。
daily.body: The national student myopia rate fell to 49.9% in 2025, down 3.7 points from 2018, marking a five-year consecutive decline.

daily.ttl: 医保新规：机器人辅助手术将单独分组报销
daily.sum: 国家医保局 DRG/DIP 3.0方案为机器人辅助手术单独设立支付分组，医院更敢尝试先进技术；同时深化'幽灵外卖'整治。
daily.body: The NHS pricing scheme (DRG/DIP 3.0) creates a standalone payment group for robot-assisted surgery, encouraging hospitals to adopt advanced tech; regulators also deepen the 'ghost takeaway' crackdown.

daily.ttl: 习近平结束出席上合峰会回到北京
daily.sum: 国家主席习近平结束出席2026年上合组织峰会及访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及后回到北京。
daily.body: President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after the SCO summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

daily.ttl: 西藏吉隆口岸供电抢通，中国对尼泊尔援助物资抵加德满都
daily.sum: 国网西藏电力抢通吉隆口岸临时供电线路；中国空军运-20运送第三批紧急援助物资抵尼泊尔，10名法医专家随行。
daily.body: State Grid restored temporary power to the Gyirong port; Chinese PLA Air Force Y-20 delivered the third batch of emergency aid to Nepal amid deadly landslides, with 10 forensic experts on board.

daily.ttl: 美军袭击致伊朗18死142伤，霍尔木兹海峡持续关闭
daily.sum: 伊朗称8月30日至9月2日美军袭击致18死142伤、3名飞行员死亡；美军海上封锁已使87艘商船改向；伊朗称未经同意霍尔木兹不会开放。

daily.ttl: 国际油价涨跌不一，避险推动黄金涨2.39%
daily.sum: 9月3日纽约轻质原油涨0.32%至91.30美元，布伦特微跌；COMEX黄金涨2.39%报4520.30美元/盎司，创高位。
daily.body: WTI rose 0.32% to $91.30; Brent slipped 0.12%. COMEX gold jumped 2.39% to $4,520.30/oz as safe-haven demand hit record highs.

daily.ttl: 全球'加息潮'再起，市场紧盯美国8月非农
daily.sum: 韩国、新西兰已连续加息，日欧美英加息预期升温；市场聚焦9月4日晚美国8月非农，美联储9月加息25基点概率约60%。
daily.body: A global rate-hike wave returns: Korea and NZ already hiked; markets watch the Aug US jobs report, with ~60% odds of a Fed 25bp hike in September.

daily.ttl: 尼泊尔泥石流遇难人数升至1290人，中方驰援获感谢
daily.sum: 尼泊尔警方确认泥石流遇难升至1290人；尼外长感谢中方慷慨驰援，中方称愿同国际社会加强合作应对气候变化。
daily.body: Nepal's landslide death toll rose to 1,290; Kathmandu thanked China for generous aid as both nations face climate-driven disasters.

daily.body: Trump said the US is ready to strike Iran again 'at any time'; Iran updated its Hormuz 'violating vessels' list to 57; Guterres urged an immediate ceasefire and a return to diplomacy.

听.title: BBC 6 Minute English: Why are we all so stressed?
听.body: Neil: Worrying about work or exams, war and climate change in the news. It's no wonder that modern life is stressful. What makes you stressed, Neil? Becca: When I'm trying to do something I've never tried before and I'm not good at it, that makes me feel really stressed. Claudia Hammond: Overwhelm is an emotional state where you are struggling with your current situation. If it becomes more of a chronic kind of stress, that might lead to burnout in the end. Neil: One simple way of combating stress is taking time to rest. According to research by Claudia Hammond, which activity is thought to be the most restful — reading for pleasure, walking in nature, or listening to music?
听.zh: 尼尔：为工作、考试、新闻里的战争与气候变暖而焦虑，现代生活充满压力也就不奇怪了。是什么让你有压力，尼尔？贝卡：当我尝试从没做过、又不擅长的事时，会真的感到压力。克劳迪娅·哈蒙德：过度负荷是一种你正与现状苦苦挣扎的情绪状态；如果变成慢性的，最终可能导致倦怠。尼尔：对抗压力的一个简单方法是留时间休息。根据哈蒙德的研究，哪种活动最让人放松——愉快地阅读、走进自然，还是听音乐？

说.title: Daily Speaking: Talk about stress & AI in your work
说.body: Describe one situation this week that made you feel overwhelmed. Then explain: (1) how you coped with it, and (2) whether you think AI tools help or hurt your focus at work. Speak for 90 seconds without notes.
说.zh: 描述本周让你感到'被压垮'的一个场景。然后说明：(1)你如何应对；(2)你认为 AI 工具是帮助你专注还是分散注意力。脱稿说 90 秒。

读.title: AI tops the agenda in ASEAN media workshop
读.body: The rise of artificial intelligence is transforming news coverage by greatly boosting efficiency, but journalists and editors also need to guard against over-reliance on AI, participants of the ASEAN Media Capacity Building Workshop stressed. Instructors highlighted AI's role as a valuable assistant in news report editing — it excels at detecting spelling and grammatical errors and extracting key information from large datasets. However, both instructors and participants cautioned against relying too heavily on AI, expressing concerns that reporters might lose their jobs if their skills are compromised by excessive dependence on technology. Romulo T. Luib emphasized that while AI can assist with preliminary tasks like information gathering, it is inadvisable to write an entire article by AI due to the risk of serious factual errors.
读.zh: 人工智能的崛起极大提升了新闻报道效率，正在重塑新闻生产，但东盟媒体能力建设研讨会的与会者强调，记者和编辑也需警惕对 AI 的过度依赖。讲师指出，AI 在新闻编辑中是得力助手——擅长发现拼写与语法错误、从海量数据中提取关键信息。然而双方也警告不要过度依赖 AI，担心记者若因重度依赖技术而削弱自身技能，可能面临失业。Romulo T. Luib 强调，尽管 AI 可辅助信息收集等前期工作，但因存在严重事实错误风险，不建议用 AI 撰写整篇文章。

写.title: Daily Writing: A brand's 'why' in the AI era
写.body: Write 150–200 words on this prompt: 'A brand that only uses AI to churn out ads will sound like everyone else. What is your brand's unique voice, and how would you protect it when using AI?' Use at least three of these words: authenticity, overload, restful, intentionality, voice.
写.zh: 写 150–200 词：'一个只靠 AI 批量生产广告的品牌，会听起来和所有人一样。你的品牌独特声音是什么？用 AI 时你如何保护它？' 至少用到三个词：authenticity, overload, restful, intentionality, voice。

练.title: Daily Practice: Vocabulary — stress & tech
练.body: Fill the gaps with the correct form: 1) Working late every day can lead to _____ (burn out / burnout). 2) She felt _____ (overwhelm / overwhelmed) by the number of emails. 3) The app helps users _____ (sharpen / sharpens) their focus. 4) Listening to music is more _____ (restful / restfully) than checking feeds. Answers: 1) burnout 2) overwhelmed 3) sharpen 4) restful.
练.zh: 用正确形式填空：1) 每天加班会导致 _____（倦怠）。2) 她被海量邮件弄得 _____（不知所措）。3) 这款应用帮用户 _____（使）注意力更集中。4) 听音乐比刷信息流更 _____（令人放松）。答案：1) burnout 2) overwhelmed 3) sharpen 4) restful。
